newsitem.title: LATVIA: Latvian share turnover jumps, Daugavpils leads.
newsitem.headline: Latvian share turnover jumps, Daugavpils leads.

text.p: Latvian stock market turnover jumped on Thursday, fuelled by secondary market share Daugavpils Chain and the usual market leader Unibanka.
Total turnover rebounded to 197,000 lats after last session's easing and the Daugavpils Chain maker traded 75,700 lats and firmed five santimes to 2.21 lats.
The usual market leader Unibanka on the main official list ended off five santimes to 3.20 lats on turnover of 57,900 lats.
The other two shares on the official list, Staburadze confectionery and Riga Transport Fleet, remained stable at 2.60 lats and 1.67 lats respectively.
Staburadze turnover eased to a small 900 lats against last session's 5598 lats. Transport Fleet gained ground to 14,400 lats from 10,350 lats.
Among fish canneries, Kaija was leading with turnover of 19,600 lats as it advanced two santimes to 2.07 lats and Roja jumped to 3.10 lats from 2.81 lats. It registered 8,900 lats of activity.
Jekabpils Sugar factory gained five santimes to 60 santimes as it saw shares worth 5,500 lats change hands.
Lode Brick maker also gained ground and registered 3,900 lats of activity as it rose 0.5 percent to 1.91 lats from 1.90 lats.
Mangali Shipyard added two santimes to close at 97 santimes, turnover easing to 1,500 lats from 3,433 lats.
